title: Enumeration adapted to Iterator
purpose: Show exact method mappings and unsupported remove for a Java object adapter.
alt: EnumerationIterator의 hasNext·next 매핑과 remove 미지원, Iterator 구현·Enumeration 위임
requiredChecks: Client uses Iterator interface hasNext()/next()/remove(); EnumerationIterator implements Iterator.
EnumerationIterator holds enumeration: Enumeration and delegates to it, with no inheritance from Enumeration.
remove()→throws UnsupportedOperationException because Enumeration lacks removal; no invented Enumeration.remove().
